Built by Donald McKay and launched in 1853 in East Boston, the clipper ship
"Great Republic"
was the summit of achievement in the world of sailing ships.
She was, from the standpoint of size, appearance and cost... the King of Clippers.
"Great Republic" was considered the largest, sharpest and most magnif-
icent craft ever produced by any nation or age. Before
she had barely tasted
Repubier, was a network of flames. She was tater rebuilt but with ser to Gage,
sail plan and spars reduced.
